Full pricing depends on your date and headcount, so let me give you the ranges first: weekday events run $180/hour (4-hour min), weekends $260/hour (5-hour min), or a full-day buyout at $2,400 weekday / $3,600 weekend. Included: setup/teardown hour on each side, AV (projector, 2 mics, Sonos), and free parking for guests. A $500 security deposit applies, returned within 7 days.

Open fall dates: 10/3, 10/10, 10/17, plus most weekdays in October.

I don't have a cancellation policy or discount structure on file — I don't want to guess on those, so let me get our events manager to confirm and they'll email you today. In the meantime, what date and headcount are you working with? That'll help me narrow down the right price point.
